'''Chapter 1073''' is titled "Miss Buckingham Stussy".

==Cover Page==
[[Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion]], Vol. 29: "Winner of the Ibel Peace Prize for 'GP Flowers' that bloom out of gunpowder."

[[Vegapunk]] creates a [[Vegapunk#Scientific Achievements|peaceful invention]].

==Short Summary==
Having taken down [[Kaku]], [[Stussy]] takes down [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] as well and is revealed to be [[Vegapunk]]'s spy. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] helps fight off [[S-Hawk]], allowing [[Vegapunk/Edison|Edison]] and [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] to regain control of the [[Seraphim]]. Meanwhile at [[Sphinx (Location)|Sphinx]], [[Polo Marco|Marco]] learns that the [[Marines]] invaded while he was gone but [[Edward Weevil|Weevil]] fought them off. [[Buckingham Stussy|Miss Buckin]] reveals to him that [[Aramaki|Ryokugyu]] captured Weevil during the invasion, so she wants Marco to get him back. Back at [[Egghead]], [[Jaygarcia Saturn]], one of the [[Five Elders]], meets with [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] to discuss Vegapunk.

==Long Summary==
Though completely caught off guard by [[Stussy]]'s sudden betrayal, [[Rob Lucci]] moves to attack her, but she sidesteps him using [[Six Powers/Kami-e#Variations|'''Kami-e "Zanshin"''']] and jams her lipstick tube—which contains a piece of [[Seastone]]—into his neck to prevent him from transforming. Stussy then bites Lucci's neck, putting him to sleep as well. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Brook]] are both left speechless by this surprising turn of events as Stussy contacts [[Vegapunk/Shaka|Shaka]] to inform him that she incapacitated both agents, revealing that she was the ally [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk]] reached out to previously. The rest of the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] are left amazed that Vegapunk was able to sneak a spy of his own into the [[World Government]]'s [[Cipher Pol|intelligence branch]] without them ever knowing her true identity, though Shaka reveals he never intended her to join them.

Despite having removed the threat, Stussy tells Shaka that her authority is the same as Lucci's, so she cannot override his orders nor stop the [[Seraphim]]. [[Vegapunk/Edison|Edison]], however, tells Stussy to fall back and let him and [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] handle the Seraphim. Zoro and Brook try to stop them too just as Lilith exits the lab. Just as she is about to issue an order, [[S-Hawk]] spots her and tries to kill her, but Zoro protects her by clashing blades with S-Hawk. Edison takes the opportunity to issue the order for the Seraphim to stand down just as [[S-Shark]] tries to shoot him. Thankfully, he is saved by [[Sanji]], and the Seraphim finally stand down. Stussy then informs Shaka that she has bound Lucci and Kaku with Seastone and he asks Stussy to join them, which she accepts. Meanwhile, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] wander the lab in search of [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]] and Vegapunk.

Meanwhile, on [[Sphinx (Location)|Sphinx]], [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]'s hometown, [[Polo Marco|Marco]] is informed by the people that while he was away, the [[Marines]] invaded trying to claim Whitebeard's treasure, with some of the people calling the bunch no different from other pirates. The leader of the attack was [[Captain (Marine Rank)|Marine Captain]] [[Ratel]], who showed no qualms telling the people of Sphinx that because they are not affiliated with the World Government, he would not hesitate to kill all of them in order to claim Whitebeard's treasure. To prove his point, he tried to shoot an old lady who badmouthed him, but thankfully, he was sent flying away by an unexpected savior in the form of [[Edward Weevil]].

Weevil's phenomenal strength ensured that the invading Marines were forced to retreat, if only to wait for backup to handle him. Marco thanks Weevil for his actions as his mother, the original [[Buckingham Stussy|Miss Buckingham Stussy]] (now known as Miss Buckin), shows up and tells him that [[Admiral]] [[Aramaki|Ryokugyu]] was dispatched to aid the Marines and that, as a result, Weevil ended up getting captured. She tells Marco to rescue Weevil and find Whitebeard's inheritance for her, but Marco's tone suggests his doubt to Buckin's claim that Weevil is Whitebeard's son. This causes Buckin to say that the only person who can confirm her words is none other than Dr. Vegapunk himself.

Meanwhile, Admiral [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] is accompanied by one of the [[Five Elders]]: [[Jaygarcia Saturn|Saint Jaygarcia Saturn]]. Kizaru asks him if he has ever met Vegapunk before, and the latter says he had once met him a long time ago, and now he feels what is transpiring now is a shame.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Rob Lucci|Lucci]] and [[Stussy]] have a short battle, with Stussy successfully biting Lucci, knocking him out.
*Stussy is revealed to have been an undercover spy for [[Vegapunk]] for the last two decades and is confirmed to have also been the one to whom Vegapunk had [[Chapter 1071|secretly contacted]] to help them.
**[[Vegapunk/Shaka|Shaka]] requests that Stussy joins Vegapunk and the satellites' journey with the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], to which she agrees.
*The [[Seraphim]] stop attacking the Labophase after [[Vegapunk/Edison|Edison]] is able to regain control of them.
*[[Polo Marco|Marco]] has returned to [[Sphinx (Location)|Sphinx]].
**While he was gone, the [[Marines]] arrived to confiscate [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]'s treasure. 
***[[Edward Weevil]] fought the Marines away from the island but was captured by [[Aramaki|Ryokugyu]].
**[[Buckingham Stussy]] is on the island and speaks with Marco, demanding that he save Weevil.
***Buckin is confirmed to be a former [[Rocks Pirates]].
**Buckin is revealed to be a [[scientist]] and a former member of [[MADS]].
***Buckin claims that Vegapunk can prove that Weevil is indeed Whitebeard's son.
*The identity of one of the [[Five Elders]] is revealed: [[Jaygarcia Saturn]].
**Jaygarcia Saturn is accompanying [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] to [[Egghead]], and he claims to have met Vegapunk a long time ago.
